target_moa.text: Fixed 1:6 combination of two blood schizontocidal antimalarials; artemether (metabolized to active DHA) acts via its endoperoxide moiety, while lumefantrine inhibits formation of β-hematin by forming a complex with hemin; both inhibit nucleic acid and protein synthesis

citations.quote: Coartem Tablets contain a fixed combination of two antimalarial active ingredients, artemether, an artemisinin derivative, and lumefantrine. Both components are blood schizontocides.
Coartem Tablets, a fixed dose combination of artemether and lumefantrine in the ratio of 1:6, is an antimalarial agent [see *Clinical Pharmacology* (12.4)].

The anti-malarial activity of artemether and DHA has been attributed to endoperoxide moiety. The exact mechanism by which lumefantrine, exerts its anti-malarial effect is not well defined. Available data suggest lumefantrine inhibits the formation of \beta-hematin by forming a complex with hemin. Both artemether and lumefantrine were shown to inhibit nucleic acid and protein synthesis.
